cases.about: The menu page differs in 6.2% of its pixels from last night's and is flagged with its three images; the home page moved 0.05% and is unchanged; today's folder is carried forward.

shell.output:
SHOT https___bakery_example_
DIFF https___bakery_example_ 1200 of 2560000
SHOT https___bakery_example_menu
DIFF https___bakery_example_menu 158720 of 2560000

call.command: cd "$PANTHEON_PROJECTS"/'shots' && d=$(date +%F) && mkdir -p $d && for u in 'https://bakery.example/' 'https://bakery.example/menu'; do n=$(printf %s "$u" | sed 's#[^A-Za-z0-9]#_#g'); chromium --headless --hide-scrollbars --window-size=1280,2000 --screenshot=$d/$n.png -- "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "SHOT $n" || echo "FAILED $u"; [ -f 2026-10-27/$n.png ] && echo "DIFF $n $(compare -metric AE $d/$n.png 2026-10-27/$n.png $d/$n.diff.png 2>&1) of $(identify -format '%[fx:w*h]' $d/$n.png)"; done

script.say:
**Changed**
- https://bakery.example/menu — 6.2% — shots/2026-10-28/https___bakery_example_menu.png vs shots/2026-10-27/https___bakery_example_menu.png, diff shots/2026-10-28/https___bakery_example_menu.diff.png

**Unchanged**
- https://bakery.example/ (0.05%)

**Could not shoot**
- none

## Report
- shot 2 pages into shots/2026-10-28 and compared them with 2026-10-27
